MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read in conjunction with, our consolidated financial statements and the accompanying Notes to Financial Statements.

OVERVIEW Microsoft is a technology company whose mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

 | TCS delivered a strong 17.6% revenue growth in FY2023, increasing from ₹1,91,754 crores to ₹2,25,458 crores.  | Tata Consultancy Services consistently maintained a net profit margin of around 19% over the three-year period — a level widely regarded as best-in-class within the Indian IT industry. Its operating profit margin also stayed above 18%, reflecting strong cost discipline and operational efficiency. Despite employee benefit expenses being the largest cost component (around 55% of revenue), the company managed to keep this ratio stable even as its workforce expanded. This indicates that TCS has been able to effectively utilize its talent pool, driving productivity gains while scaling operations.

 | Tata Consultancy Services improved its ROE from 46.2% to 49.1%, meaning it earns about ₹0.49 profit for every ₹1 invested by shareholders. This is higher than most companies, showing strong efficiency, smart use of capital, and good management.

 | 4. GROWING DIVIDEND SIGNALS STRONG CASH GENERATION
 | Tata Consultancy Services increased its dividend per share from ₹43 to ₹56 in three years (about 30% growth). It is also paying a slightly higher share of its profits to investors, backed by strong cash generation. This shows good financial health and a shareholder-friendly approach.
